Name: ElementEntryId
Label: Element Entry ID
Description: An application generated value to uniquely identify the element entry. Not available when creating new records.

Name: AssignmentNumber
Label: Assignment Number
Description: The number of the person's assignment for the element entry.

Name: ElementName
Label: Element Name
Description: The name of the element this entry is for, such as Performance Bonus.

Name: EntryType
Label: Entry Type
Description: The type of record, such as element entry, or override.

Name: LegislativeDataGroupName
Label: Legislative Data Group Name
Description: The name of the legislative data group.

Name: MultipleEntryCount
Label: Multiple Entry Count
Description: A number to uniquely identify the element entry when multiple entries exist for the person and element in the same period.

Name: EffectiveEndDate
Label: Effective End Date
Description: The end date of the date-effective changes. If left blank, the effective end date is the end of time by default.

Name: EffectiveStartDate
Label: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the record or of date-effective changes to the record.

Name: AssignmentId
Label: Assignment ID
Description: The surrogate ID of the payroll assignment this element entry is for.

Name: CreatorType
Label: Creator Type
Description: The name for the type of user or process that created the record, such as batch element entry.

Name: DateEarned
Label: Date Earned
Description: The date used to identify the element entries that must be included in the payroll run. For example, if the date earned for a payroll run is 6th April, then all entries that are active as of this date are included.

Name: ElementTypeId
Label: Element Type ID
Description: A unique reference to the element type this entry is for.

Name: HrAssignmentId
Label: HR Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment associated to the employee.

Name: LegislativeDataGroupId
Label: Legislative Data Group ID
Description: A unique reference to the legislative data group.

Name: Reason
Label: Reason
Description: The reason for creating or updating the element entry.

Name: Subpriority
Label: Subpriority
Description: Determines the sequence for processing element entries that have the same priority.

Name: SourceSystemId
Label: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: SourceSystemOwner
Label: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: GUID
Label: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: SourceRefTableName
Label: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
